response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - baseline.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE share > baseline.average_share;
